name: Características de Textura Tamura
description: Extrae perceptual texture características (coarseness, contraste, directionality) para identificar unnatural texture characteristics typical of generado por IA images.
mechanism: Computes Tamura coarseness mediante el análisis de local average differences at multiple scales, and directionality by computing gradiente orientation histogramas. AI images tend to have lower coarseness and more isotropic gradiente distribucións.
parameters: Scales: 5 levels (2^1 to 2^5), Gradient: Sobel operator, Orientation bins: 16
accuracy: Moderada — 65-78%, mejor como señal de textura complementaria
source: Tamura, H. et al. (1978) — Textural Features Corresponding to Visual Perception, IEEE SMC
useCase: Detecting unnatural texture properties in generado por IA surfaces and materials

references.title: Tamura, H. et al. (1978). Textural Features Corresponding to Visual Perception. IEEE SMC.

strengths:
• Perceptually meaningful características
• Captures texture at multiple scales
• Independent of image content
• Fast computation
limitations:
• Lower standalone precisión
• Sensitive to image resolución
• May overlap with other texture methods
• AI improving at texture generation
